items.question: Send this public repository's author test files and criteria to TypeSafe (Jev) in shadow mode?
options: Send them in shadow, key only in the gitignored local .mcp.json; tradr stays off until its DPA is read
Keep the judge off until a later spec

items.question: Where does an author's SEAM-DEFECT route?
options: The existing design-defect stop (supervisor re-opens design)
A narrower tasks-defect stop that re-opens only the tasks phase

items.question: Allow a per-project red-on-base: off key in the agent rules?
options: Allow it, default on; off keeps the author, skips the base run and scores every marked task high

items.question: Should the gate count the author's test files as listed files and as touched test paths for the existing rules?
options: Count them (otherwise every marked task in the shared-repo layout scores high on tests-not-touched)
Leave the gate inputs as they are

items.question: Top-level money, personal-data-and-erasure, and legal/compliance posture (refunds and forfeiture, credits, legal framing)?
options: n/a — the spec touches no money, personal data, or legal surface
Treat the TypeSafe data egress as a compliance surface and hold it for a DPA review
